title: The native smooth map has normalized finite traces and integral reconstruction
statement: Let ell be prime and k a field of positive characteristic unequal to ell. Let f:X→Y be a k-morphism between separated finite-type k-schemes, smooth of pure relative dimension d. Then there exist quasi-compactness and separatedness witnesses for f, a compactification c of f, and Noetherian witnesses for X and Y such that ReconstructionResult(ell,f,d,c) of [lem-pur-condensed-tate-integral-tower] holds. For the same witnesses there exist positive finite levels s_n:Level(ell,n+1,f,d) and quotient ReductionData r_{b,a} for every a≤b [def-pur-finite-smooth-adjunction-data] such that (1) each finite ordinary smooth trace represents Hom into f^*(-)(d)[2d], on every ordinary derived source test and every bounded constructible finite-Tor target test; (2) every pro-etale finite trace satisfies exactly the actual counit quotient equation of [lem-pur-finite-trace-quotient-counit] for r_{b,a}. The ReconstructionResult is retained intact, so these same supplied finite levels and quotient maps can be used in its universally quantified normalized Tate/unit reconstruction clause. This is only the finite and integral input package; it asserts no unnormalized condensed trace uniqueness.

theorem smoothTrace_nativeSystem
    (ell : ℕ) [Fact ell.Prime] (k : Type u) [Field k] [Fact (ringChar k ≠ ell)]
    (hchar : 0 < ringChar k)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (.of k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [IsSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spec (.of k))] (d : ℕ) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d f] :
    ∃ (hfq : QuasiCompact f) (hfs : IsSeparated f) (c : Compactification f)
      (hX : IsNoetherian X) (hY : IsNoetherian Y),
      let := hfq
      let := hfs
      let := c.hasCompactification
      let := hX
      let := hY
      ReconstructionResult ell f d hfq hfs c hX hY ∧
      ∃ (s : ∀ n : ℕ, Level ell (n + 1) f d)
        (r : ∀ (b a : ℕ) (hab : a ≤ b),
          ReductionData (FiniteReduction.quotient.{u} ell (Nat.add_le_add_right hab 1))
            f d (s b) (s a)),
        (∀ (n : ℕ) (K : Etale.DerivedCategoryModule (coefficient.{u} ell (n + 1)) Y),
          Etale.DerivedCategory.boundedConstructibleFiniteTor (coefficient ell (n + 1)) Y K →
          ∀ Q : Etale.DerivedCategoryModule (coefficient.{u} ell (n + 1)) X,
            Function.Bijective
              (fun v : Q ⟶ (puritySource (coefficient ell (n + 1)) f
                (line (coefficient ell (n + 1)) (ell ^ (n + 1))
                  (CharP.cast_eq_zero _ _) X d)).obj K ↦
                (Etale.rightDerivedLowerShriek
                  (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (coefficient ell (n + 1))) f).map v ≫
                  trace (coefficient ell (n + 1)) f
                    (line (coefficient ell (n + 1)) (ell ^ (n + 1))
                      (CharP.cast_eq_zero _ _) X d) (s n).alpha K)) ∧
        ∀ (b a : ℕ) (hab : a ≤ b),
          let A := coefficient.{u} ell (b + 1)
          let B := coefficient.{u} ell (a + 1)
          let phi := FiniteReduction.quotient.{u} ell (Nat.add_le_add_right hab 1)
          let LA := line A (ell ^ (b + 1)) (CharP.cast_eq_zero _ _) X d
          let LB := line B (ell ^ (a + 1)) (CharP.cast_eq_zero _ _) X d
          ∀ (K : proCategory A Y), IsCtf A Y K →
            (proCompact B f).map
                ((proScalar phi X).map (proGamma A f LA (s b).alpha K)) ≫
              proCompactCoefficientInverse phi f ((exceptional A f).obj K) ≫
                (proScalar phi Y).map (proCounit A f K) =
            (proCompact B f).map (proLambda f d (r b a hab).twist K) ≫
              proTrace B f LB (s a).alpha ((proScalar phi Y).obj K)
